thread:
jess: Heads-up — Acme (acct_acme_01) says their Feb invoice inv_2025_02_774 is missing three overage line items that are visible on the dashboard. Screenshot: https://s3.redwood.ai/attachments/acme/feb-invoice-mismatch.png
omar: Can you drop acct + invoice id? I can pull ledger.
jess: acct: acct_acme_01, invoice: inv_2025_02_774. Dashboard shows lines dated 2025-02-28 23:59 with ~120k tokens labeled 'standard overage'.
linda: I see dashboard totals include ~120k extra tokens on 2/28 but invoice shows $0 for overage. Any auto-credits ran? @maya_finance
maya_finance: No manual credits on that account. Running a quick billing line query now.
maya_finance: Query I ran: ```SELECT invoice_id, line_type, amount_cents FROM billing_lines WHERE invoice_id='inv_2025_02_774';``` returns base plan + credits but no overage lines.
fred_sre: Could be metering ingestion window mismatch — dashboard aggregates by event_ts UTC, billing snapshot uses account billing_day_cutoff (account timezone). Check account timezone.
jess: Account timezone is America/Los_Angeles.
omar: If billing cutoff used account TZ, some 2/28 PST events become 3/1 UTC and may fall into next invoice. Customer insists dashboard shows them in Feb — need deterministic repro.
linda: Repro steps I'll run: 1) run metering SQL per account_id & day; 2) compare billed_token_count from billing_exports for invoice_id; 3) diff and produce sample event ids.
support-ash: I'll run steps and paste output.
support-ash: Quick curl to invoices API: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoices/inv_2025_02_774` — response shows line_items array, confirmed missing overage rows.
fred_sre: Ping @billing-bot for ingestion-lag logs for acct_acme_01 2025-02-28 -> 2025-03-02
billing-bot: ingestion-lag: acct_acme_01 had a delayed batch processed 2025-03-01T02:12:03Z in v2-metrics-loader. Batch marked 'late' and routed to next invoice by current connector.
maya_finance: That looks like root cause — late batch processed after billing snapshot. We don't drop usage but it gets applied to next invoice. We can offer manual adjustment to reconcile Feb.
omar: Why did v2-metrics-loader mark batch late? fred, any infra issues that window?
fred_sre: There was an S3 read timeout in eu-west mirror 2025-03-01 01:50-02:20 UTC. Retries delayed a subset of batches. Opening follow-up incident.
jess: Customer wants correction this month. @maya_finance what's our policy?
maya_finance: Policy: late-ingested usage is billed on next invoice by default. We can issue a post-invoice adjustment credit or generate a corrected invoice manually. I'll prepare options for the customer.
jess: :thumbsup: Please prepare adjustment and include explanation: 'usage events delayed due to metrics ingestion lag — lines applied to next billing period; credit issued to reconcile Feb totals.'
omar: I'll attach ledger export + delayed batch ids. Support please confirm sample events for signoff.
support-ash: Sample event ids: evt_987654, evt_987655, evt_987656 — tokens map to 40k / 50k / 30k.
maya_finance: Thanks. Preparing adjustment draft and cc'ing legal/compliance if needed. Also recommend an internal postmortem in eng-infra.
jess: Created ticket BL-2025-301 (billing adjustment & comms). Tagging @fred_sre @omar @maya_finance. I'll notify the customer with proposed remedy.
fred_sre: I'll own the infra follow-up. Root cause: S3 read timeout -> delayed batch -> metrics-loader routed to next snapshot. Action items: add tighter retry/backpressure thresholds + alerting on delayed batches.
jess: Thanks all — I'll update this thread when customer responds.
